scripts.dev: npm run db:up && sleep 5 && npm run db:push && npm run db:generate && concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && cross-env PORT=3001 npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.db:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
